subject: Confirmation of Flight Booking
body: Dear [Name], We are pleased to confirm your flight booking for your upcoming trip from New York to London. Your flight details are as follows: - Departure: June 15th, 2021 at 10:00 AM - Arrival: June 15th, 2021 at 10:00 PM - Flight number: ABC123 Please ensure you arrive at the airport at least 2 hours before departure. If you have any questions or need assistance, feel free to contact us. We wish you a pleasant journey! Best regards, The Airline Team
